sections.title: Stagger and Ragdoll
sections.content: Staggering can range from mere flinching to being knocked off your feet entirely. It is caused by dealing or taking damage with sufficient Stagger Force to meet an enemy's stagger thresholds. Higher thresholds impart stronger effects, such as completely interrupting animations. Unlike other status effects, Stagger Force does not build up over multiple attacks.

subsections.title: Enemies
subsections.content:
• Staggering will cause an enemy to be pushed back and usually interrupts their movement, with the distance pushed scaling with Stagger Force.
  • Most enemies have abilities that can be interrupted upon being attacked with sufficient Stagger Force.
    • Some notable interruptable abilities include certain attacks and calling for reinforcements.
    • Stagger thresholds listed on enemy pages will be the value required to cause interrupting stagger.
  • Stagger Force required to interrupt an enemy can vary wildely, from the lowely Scavenger's 1 to the unyielding Fleshmob's 45.
  • Weapons that fire multiple projectiles (Such as the SG-8 Punisher) will have every projectile apply full Stagger Force, allowing just a single pellet to stagger an enemy.

sections.title: Fire Panic
sections.content:
An effect similar to Gas Confusion, enemies hit by a direct stream of fire will move and attack randomly. Only direct-flame firing weapons such as the FLAM-40 Flamethrower, B/FLAM-80 Cremator, A/FLAM-40 Flame Sentry, FLAM-66 Torcher, and (uniquely) 40-K Meltagun can apply this effect. Heavy/Massive enemies are immune to this effect.

sections.title: Gas
sections.content: Enemies and Helldivers afflicted by gas will suffer damage over time only to the Main health pool, as well as the Gas Confusion status effect on anything inside the gas cloud. The disorientation effect is delayed if the affected unit was already engaged in an attack motion (e.g. an Overseer chasing a Helldiver).

sections.content: After being afflicted by Gas, enemies and Helldivers will enter a confused state which disrupts a Helldiver's vision, and causes enemies to move and attack in random directions, typically away from Helldivers. All units afflicted by gas are also slowed by 25%.

sections.title: Change History
sections.content:
Patch
Description

1.006.100
2026-03-17

Changes

  • Fire will now cause slowing effects and confusion effects on small to medium sized enemies

1.003.000
2025-05-13

Changes

  • Fire has been reworked to deal damage based on the "Size" of the enemy
    • Small enemies take less burning damage and Larger enemies take more burning damage
  • Large and Robotic Enemies require more burning status buildup before being ignited

Undocumented Changes

  • Burn damage increased from 50 to 100.
  • Heavy Burn armor penetration increased from  Light to  Heavy
  • Heavy Burn standard damage decreased from 400 to 200
  • Heavy Burn durable damage increased from 80 to 200
